acceptanceCriteria: A resumed route compares the prefix receipt's Prev digest with the checkpoint-bound chain, or the spec states why presence suffices.
A forged-Prev fixture falls back to the complete audit.
body: PR #1075 (V1-1650) added chain-position checks to priorPost: Seq, Prev presence, HeadGeneration. The Prev digest value is not compared on resumed read/writer routes; only the complete audit checks it. Suspected gap, not a confirmed exploit.
